newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian PM names new economy minister.
newsitem.headline: Croatian PM names new economy minister.

text.p: Croatian Prime Minister Zlatko Matesa on Thursday named Nenad Porges, current economic adviser at the Croatian embassy in Washington, as the new economy minister.
Porges, aged 51, has an economics degree from Zagreb University. His former roles include that of a deputy economy minister and economic adviser to the prime minister.
He is also said to be fluent in three foreign languages.
"All this offers us guarantees that he will be able to discharge his duty very successfully," Matesa told reporters.
Porges will replace Davor Stern, who was appointed earlier this week to head the national oil and gas company INA Industrija Nafte which is undergoing radical restructuring.
